seo.title: Breathe Easy — Guided Breathing Timer for iOS
seo.description: A simple, beautiful breathing timer that helps you relax and focus. Box breathing, 4-7-8, and coherent breathing patterns. Apple Watch, HealthKit, no subscriptions.

hero.label: GUIDED BREATHING TIMER
hero.title: Find your calm. Just breathe.
text: A simple, beautiful breathing timer that helps you relax and focus. No accounts, no subscriptions, no data collection.

items.title: Proven Patterns
items.text: Box breathing, 4-7-8 relaxation, and Coherent breathing — each backed by science to help you relax, focus, or sleep.

items.title: Visual Guide
items.text: The breathing circle expands and contracts to match your breath perfectly. Close your eyes and let haptic cues guide you.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: The standalone watch app runs without your iPhone. Start a breathing session from your wrist with full haptic guidance.

items.title: HealthKit Sync
items.text: Sessions automatically save to Apple Health as mindfulness minutes. Track your practice alongside everything else.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets to start a session instantly. One tap to calm.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your breathing data stays on your device. Period.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Breathe Easy doesn't even make network requests. Your session data lives on your device and nowhere else.

cta.title: Start breathing.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
